aiVerification.summary: Draft has valid source context but changed-factor and outcome grouping are materially incorrect.

Bonding/no-bonding is crossed condition, not preserved correctly.
Spot welding result covers only one pair and misses report conclusion.
Function and tension outcomes are incomplete or mis-extracted.
Header-derived measurement rows are invalid evidence.
correctionPlan: Define factors as treatment type crossed with coating status versus normal where applicable.
Preserve coating status as subgroup or separate factor consistently.
Rebuild spot welding comparisons for all listed treatment/coating rows.
Rebuild function and tension outcomes from real data rows only.
Remove header-based measurement artifacts and cite decision rows.
